name: io.github.tonyyang0504/outbrain-mcp
description: Outbrain Amplify (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, pause_resume. Every tool maps

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_OUTBRAIN_OB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Amplify API token, sent as the OB-TOKEN-V1 header. Obtain it with `curl -u USER:PASSWORD https://api.outbrain.com/amplify/v0.1/login` (Basic auth; the response is {"OB-TOKEN-V1": "…"}); tokens last 30 days, so re-issue and replace it monthly. Amplify API access requires Outbrain's approval.
